channel.title: Pet Care, Plainly
channel.description: The basics of caring for a new pet, explained clearly.

item.title: Foods That Are Toxic to Dogs and Cats, the Official List
item.description: ASPCA Poison Control's list of people foods pets should not eat, why chocolate, grapes, onions, and xylitol are risky, and what to do if a pet eats one.

item.title: How Pet Microchips Work, and Why Registration Matters Most
item.description: AVMA and AAHA answers on what a pet microchip is, what it stores, how it is implanted, what it costs, and the registration step many owners miss.

item.title: A Daily Care Checklist for New Pet Owners
item.description: A daily and seasonal pet care checklist built from official AVMA and ASPCA resources, covering vaccines, hygiene, and emergency readiness.

item.title: Reading a Pet Food Label, What AAFCO Requires
item.description: A guide to the required parts of a pet food label, including the nutritional adequacy statement and guaranteed analysis, based on AAFCO and FDA guidance.

item.title: What to Do in Your Pet's First Week Home
item.description: A first-week checklist for new pet owners based on official AVMA and CDC guidance, covering vet visits, hygiene, and choosing the right pet.

item.title: What US Rules Say About Flying with Your Dog
item.description: What the CDC Dog Import Form actually requires, how long it stays valid, and the extra steps for dogs arriving from high-risk rabies countries.
